quickAnswer: Office cleaning cost in Dallas, TX tracks almost exactly at the US national baseline with a 0.99x metro multiplier, translating to $35 to $59 per billed hour ($54 to $94/hr specialty) and an $89 to $134 minimum visit charge. For a 5,000 sq ft carpeted suite with two restrooms cleaned 3x/week (13.0 visits/month), monthly pricing averages $5,888 to $9,942 ($453 to $765 per visit, or $0.09 to $0.15/sq ft).

blocks.text: Dallas serves as one of the country's most transparent commercial cleaning benchmarks because its **0.99x regional cost multiplier** sits virtually dead-even with the `1.00x` US average. Yet two identical 10,000 sq ft tenants—one leasing a high-rise floor in **Uptown** or the **Downtown Arts District**, and another occupying a corporate campus in **Las Colinas** or **Legacy West**—routinely receive quotes separated by 18% to 25% due to tower access rules, parking fees, and construction-dust remediation.

Comparing Dallas against our [150-city US pricing index](/city-cleaning-costs/) reveals why DFW sits slightly below [Austin (`1.03x`)](/city-cleaning-costs/office-cleaning-cost-austin-tx/) while outpacing [San Antonio (`0.90x`)](/city-cleaning-costs/office-cleaning-cost-san-antonio-tx/) and [Jacksonville (`0.92x`)](/city-cleaning-costs/office-cleaning-cost-jacksonville-fl/). Below are exact calculator-aligned budgets and procurement checkpoints for Dallas office managers.
2026 Dallas Office Cleaning Budgets Across 2k to 25k Sq Ft

Dallas janitorial vendors apply standard square-footage brackets (`$0.12–$0.20/sq ft` under 2,500 sq ft, `$0.09–$0.15/sq ft` from 2,500–9,999 sq ft, `$0.07–$0.12/sq ft` from 10,000–24,999 sq ft, and `$0.05–$0.10/sq ft` at 25,000+ sq ft) scaled by `0.99x`, plus `$14.85–$29.70` (`~$15–$30`) per restroom per visit. Monthly retainers below use **4.333 weeks per month** (`8.66`, `13.00`, and `21.65` visits).

blocks.text: Uptown Towers vs. Las Colinas and Legacy West Campuses

Dallas contractors pay a **$16.34/hr BLS median janitor wage reference**, translating into **$35 to $59 per billed hour** for recurring maintenance and **$54 to $94 per hour** for specialty restorative work. Submarket logistics dictate where your bid lands inside that range.

In **Uptown** and the **Downtown Arts District**, high-rise property managers enforce strict after-hours freight-elevator windows, security-badged keycard check-ins, and structured garage parking for evening technicians—all of which trim productive cleaning minutes and push billing toward `$46–$59/hr`. Conversely, horizontal corporate campuses in **Las Colinas** and **Legacy West** provide free surface or deck parking and multi-tenant route density, keeping recurring rates closer to `$35–$48/hr` unless executive suites incorporate extensive engineered hardwood.

blocks.title: Dallas 5,000 Sq Ft Schedule Cost Ladder
blocks.text: For a 5,000 sq ft carpeted suite with two restrooms at Dallas's 0.99x multiplier: 1x/week runs $511–$861/visit ($2,212–$3,729/mo), 2x/week runs $475–$802/visit ($4,115–$6,944/mo), 3x/week runs $453–$765/visit ($5,888–$9,942/mo), and 5x/week weekday runs $431–$728/visit ($9,324–$15,754/mo).
Spring Pollen, Urban Construction Dust, and Scope Add-Ons

Heavy spring oak and ragweed pollen combined with continuous commercial infill construction along McKinney Avenue, Victory Park, and Legacy Drive introduce fine silica and drywall particulates through lobby revolving doors and HVAC return vents. Suites near active crane zones require true **HEPA-filtered vacuuming** on upholstery and workstations alongside frequent **interior glass wiping** so conference rooms do not accumulate hazy film.

Class A Tower $2M Liability & Keycard Compliance

blocks.title: Dallas Class A Property Management COI Requirements
blocks.text: High-rise property managers across Uptown, Downtown, and Legacy West routinely reject standard $1M policies. Require every bidder to furnish a Certificate of Insurance showing $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 aggregate Commercial General Liability (with Additional Insured and Waiver of Subrogation endorsements), Texas Workers' Compensation, a $25,000+ fidelity bond, background-screened W-2 keycard rosters, and OSHA HazCom (29 CFR 1910.1200) + Bloodborne Pathogens (29 CFR 1910.1030) documentation.
Floor Care Hardware for Dallas Mixed-Surface Offices
Many Dallas suites blend executive hardwood boardrooms with VCT breakrooms and ceramic restrooms. Matching mop systems to each surface prevents water warping and cross-contamination:

items: **Rubbermaid Commercial WaveBrake 35-Quart Mop Bucket & Side-Press Wringer:** A 35-quart baffled bucket with a side-press wringer rated for a 5-year wringer duty life (200,000+ cycles), preventing splash streaks in stone elevator foyers and multi-stall restrooms.

**Rubbermaid Commercial HYGEN Charging Bucket:** Holds 20 color-coded microfiber flat-mop pads beneath a tight snap lid for OSHA-ready pre-soak chemical dosing without dipping soiled pads back into clean solution.

**O-Cedar ProMist MAX Commercial Microfiber Spray Mop:** A 14.5-inch double-sided, machine-washable microfiber pad paired with a low-moisture onboard spray bottle—ideal for spot spills on engineered hardwood conference rooms.

faqs.q: What is the average hourly office cleaning rate in Dallas, TX?
faqs.a: Standard commercial cleaning vendors in Dallas bill $35 to $59 per hour (0.99x national multiplier) based on a $16.34/hr BLS median janitor wage reference. Specialty floor stripping, stone crystallization, and carpet extraction bill at $54 to $94 per hour.

faqs.q: Why do Uptown Dallas high-rises cost more to clean than Las Colinas office parks?
faqs.a: Uptown and Downtown Arts District towers require $2,000,000 aggregate General Liability COIs, background-checked after-hours keycard access, freight-elevator scheduling windows, and paid evening parking—typically adding 10% to 18% overhead compared with suburban surface-parked campuses.

faqs.q: How much does 5,000 sq ft office cleaning cost per month in Dallas?
faqs.a: For a 5,000 sq ft carpeted office with two restrooms, Dallas monthly rates average $2,212 to $3,729 (1x/week), $4,115 to $6,944 (2x/week), $5,888 to $9,942 (3x/week at 13.0 visits), and $9,324 to $15,754 (5x/week at 21.65 visits) before optional consumables.

faqs.q: How does 4.333 weeks per month math affect my Dallas cleaning invoice?
faqs.a: Because a 52-week year averages 4.333 weeks per month, reputable Dallas contractors multiply 3x/week rates by 13.0 visits/month and 5x/week rates by 21.65 visits/month so fifth weeks in longer calendar months are covered evenly.

faqs.q: What items are excluded from a typical Dallas recurring janitorial agreement?
faqs.a: Base monthly scopes normally exclude quarterly carpet extraction or VCT waxing ($0.030–$0.059/sq ft/month amortized), paper and soap consumables ($0.012–$0.025/sq ft/visit), exterior glass, interior refrigerator cleanouts, and post-construction dust removal.
